Products of SUTS and TE were reported to exceed 8 GPa·g⁻¹·cm³·% for DP1000-5 and DP1050-1, while for 2000 series Al alloys and Ti6Al4V they are less than 4 GPa·g⁻¹·cm³·%, and 2.7–6.5 and 2.9–7.4 GPa·g⁻¹·cm³·% for duplex and austenitic Fe-Mn-Al-C steels respectively; DP950-5 is one of the 'Our steel' red-star data points in Fig. 3b.

In the CR structure (prior to annealing), ferrite has two morphologies: granular ferrite at austenite triple points (0.6–1.8 µm) and band-like δ ferrite elongated along the RD (length 12–30 µm, thickness 2–6 µm); the δ ferrite is traced to the preceding HR/solidification structure.
β-Mn phase was detected by XRD at 700–900 °C but not at 950 °C (the DP950-5 annealing temperature).
